description: Make Godot games: a project type that plays in the game panel as a web build, tools and an MCP server to build scenes and run the game, and skills for scenes and scripts.
type.title: Godot game
type.description: A Godot 4 project. Needs Godot 4.3 or later with its web export templates.
config.godotPath.description: Leave empty to use GODOT_PATH, then the PATH and the usual install folders.
longDescription: Create scenes and scripts, import game assets, run scenes headless, launch the editor or the game, and read debug output. A Godot game project plays in the game panel as a web build; in other projects, turn Godot on in the project's plugins. Requires a local Godot 4 installation, and Node.js with npx for the Godot MCP server. Visual inspection and gameplay input need a separate supported workflow.
example.1: Create a playable 3D scene in Godot.
example.2: Inspect the current Godot project and suggest the next implementation step.
example.3: Build a player controller for the current Godot scene.
mcp.title: Godot MCP
